World rule: Value contrast: road base #d7e1e8, pavement #f1e9e5, square #ece6fa, claimed lot #e9e2da and the ivory ceramic material are all within a few percent luminance of each other, and the buildings, figures and dog are ivory too. On a compressed livestream the whole town turns white on white. Set the road to a mid ceramic slate (around #8e9cab), the square to a warmer, darker tile (around #d6cdea with #a99cc8 seams), and require every built piece to carry at least one mid or dark accent (navy #36495e, lilac #8c80b4 or tan #bca783) on its silhouette.
